maker: Christian Gottlob Eschenbach, Neukirchen (bell sec. only)
signature: “C G ESCHENBACH A NEUKIRCHEN 1799” (with blossoms between words and initials) ; on both sides of the stays: initials "N I" (or "N 1").
dimensions: be 110, h 495, thickness of metal 0.5, length of slide section 760, tube portion 450, bell pipe 33, diameter at begnning last portion of [cylindrical] tube 13, diameter of tube at beginning of bell section 54.
remarks: Small cracks, hard-soldered, in bell sec.. Flat bell stay with four points****, fastened on bell-pipe side with a hinge and on neck-pipe side with a ferrule. On both sides of bell stay, border of hatched lines. In the same way is the ferrule adjacent to the hinge and the bell bow decorated with heart-shaped ornaments. The saddle in the middle of the bell bow formerly had a ring mounted on it. The remaining ferrules have grooves in groups of twos and threes.
